title: Demonic Path Secrets
next_chapter_hook: The token fragment carved with the Chen Family emblem lay quietly in Ye Qing's palm. Under the candlelight, a name long since obliterated flickered into view—Chen Xuan's son, do you wish to know who truly killed your father all those years ago?

text.content: The resonance of the communication Jade Slip had yet to fade when Chen Ji's fingertips still trembled slightly. As the candlelight flickered, he stared at the now-dimmed Jade Slip, his pupils churning with tumultuous waves. Eighteen years. That name was like a rusted iron box buried in the deepest corners of his heart, now suddenly pried open, with a gust of blood-scented wind rushing forth.

Chen Xuan. His father, the most dazzling genius disciple of the Tianqing Sect a hundred years ago, and also an existence deliberately erased by the sect. The familiar yet strange voice from the Jade Slip still echoed in his ears—after the two words "Chen Xuan" came an encrypted coordinate and a name fragment that sent a chill down his spine.

dialogue.content: It seems Young Master Chen has received an interesting message.

text.content: A shadow moved outside the window, a graceful figure silently landing on the windowsill. Ye Qing wore a玄black cloak, surrounded by wisps of demonic aura that shifted like phantoms. Those star-filled eyes surveyed with interest the knuckles of Chen Ji's tightly gripping the Jade Slip—white bones, with veins subtly visible.

dialogue.content: Saint Maiden Ye is in high spirits, visiting so late at night. Aren't you afraid the Tianqing Sect's patrol disciples will recognize that striking face of yours?
Tianqing Sect's patrol disciples?

Ye Qing laughed softly, her slender finger flicking outward. In the night fog outside the window, several figures collapsed soundlessly. She withdrew her hand, her expression as calm as if brushing off a speck of dust. "Already cleaned up for you. Now, can we discuss business, Young Master Chen?"

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but he secretly pocketed the Jade Slip into his sleeve. Looking at this Demon Path Saint Maiden before him, alarm bells rang in his heart—she had come too conveniently, on the very same night he learned news of his father. There are no coincidences in this world, only layouts yet to be unveiled.

Business? Chen has no business with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. He walked unhurriedly toward the table, pouring himself a cup of cold tea. If the Saint Maiden wishes to recruit, Chen can make it clear—the life of a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple isn't worth that much.

dialogue.content: Servant Disciple?

Ye Qing's smile deepened. Those dark purple eyes seemed capable of seeing through the human heart. Someone possessing a Tianji Record Fragment, able to peer into three hours of Heavenly Secrets, if merely a Servant Disciple, then wouldn't all cultivators under heaven be ants? She approached slowly, the wind from her robes carrying a wisp of cold chill. Young Master Chen, we are both intelligent people—why speak such self-deceiving nonsense?

text.content: The candlelight flickered. Chen Ji's hand holding the tea remained motionless, yet a cold gleam passed through the depths of his eyes. She knew indeed. This woman knew more than he had anticipated. The aura of the Tianji Record had been concealed by Mo Xiansheng using a secret method, even Su Qingyao could only sense mere traces. How could Ye Qing be so certain?

dialogue.content: Don't be nervous. Ye Qing raised her hand, and a hazy light figure emerged in the void. It was a bird's-eye view of the endless demonic army camps, with banners shading the sun and killing intent surging to the heavens. This Saint Maiden comes to tell Young Master Chen a secret—the Demonic Path is far from united.

text.content: In the light figure, the army camps were distinctly divided into three sections. Ye Qing's slender finger pointed to the largest central camp, her voice chilling: These are Commander Li Qingming's direct disciples—strongest in combat power, most fanatical. To the Commander's left are the conservative forces within the Holy Sect, advocating steady advancement, nourishing war with war. To the right... her finger paused momentarily, complex emotions flickering in her eyes, those are my people.

dialogue.content: Saint Maiden Ye actually commands such forces within the demonic army? Chen Ji set down his teacup, his gaze falling upon that light figure. May I ask, Saint Maiden, we are strangers—why reveal these to me?

text.content: Ye Qing withdrew the light figure and turned to face Chen Ji directly. Candlelight painted half her face bright, half hidden in shadow, as if she herself embodied the dual identity of light and darkness. Because I have a request of you. She spoke candidly. You can see the future, and what I must do—I cannot afford to lose.

dialogue.content: Moreover... she shifted topics, a meaningful curve forming on her lips. Your father Chen Xuan and the demonic army's Commander Li Qingming were old acquaintances.

text.content: The air seemed to solidify. Chen Ji's fingers gripping the teacup tightened abruptly, his joints creaking. His heartbeat thundered in his ears through the silent night, yet his face remained that calm, unruffled expression. Only he knew that the two words "old acquaintance" were like two dull blades, sawing back and forth at his heart.

dialogue.content: Old acquaintance? This Chen knows not what the Saint Maiden speaks of. He set down the teacup, his voice平静得近乎冷漠，先父不过天青宗一介弟子，如何攀得上魔道主帅？圣女若想以此试探，未免太小看陈某了。
试探？夜清轻嗤一声，玄气涌动间，一枚残破的令牌凭空浮现在她掌心。令牌虽已残缺大半，但那斑驳的纹路——赫然是陈家的家徽！烛火映照下，一个早已模糊的名字在令牌背面若隐若现：陈、玄、之、印。

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. That token he knew too well—as a child, he had seen his father staring at an identical token alone late at night, his expression grief-stricken. Back then he was too young to understand; now he realized the token bore the Chen family's final dignity and blood debt.

dialogue.content: 厉青冥，你想知道他是怎么死的吗？夜清将令牌悬于指尖，声音不高，却字字诛心。十八年前，令尊陈玄并非死于天青宗内乱，而是死在——她故意停顿，观察着陈机微微颤抖的睫毛，厉青冥的算计之下。

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, chair legs scraping against the floor with a harsh sound. He stared at that token, his eyes churning with vast hatred and chilling killing intent, yet his expression反而平静下来。这种平静比暴怒更可怕——那是暴风雨来临前的死寂。

dialogue.content: "What does the Holy Maiden want?" He spoke word by word, his voice terrifyingly steady. "Chen Mou does not believe you would casually share such secrets. Speak. What do you want me to do before you'll tell me everything about this token's origin and the matter between Li Qingming and my late father?"

text.content: Ye Qing retracted the token, a flicker of appreciation dancing in those deep violet eyes. "Young Master Chen is indeed straightforward." She sat across the table, her slender fingers tapping lightly on the surface. "An alliance. I need an equal ally, someone who can coordinate with me at critical moments. You possess the Tianji Record, while I have intelligence on the Demonic Path and some of its subordinate forces. Cooperation benefits us both."

dialogue.content: "Equal?" Chen Ji冷笑, "The Holy Maiden speaks of alliance yet offers no concrete terms. Forgive my bluntness, but an alliance with empty promises is no different from waste paper." His gaze cut like a blade as he stared into Ye Qing's eyes. "If the Holy Maiden truly has sincerity, why not first tell me about Li Qingming and my father's past? As for alliance terms—though Chen Mou is crippled, I'm not a soft persimmon anyone can squeeze."

text.content: Ye Qing tilted her head, as if examining an interesting toy. "Young Master Chen is indeed tough." Her fingertips caressed the token fragment, her voice unhurried. "This token came to me by chance. There are no more than three people in the world who know its origin." She raised her gaze, eyes glittering. "If Young Master Chen refuses the alliance, you may not even verify this token's authenticity, let alone learn the truth behind your father's death."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then the corner of his lips curved upward slightly. That smile was cold as frost, carrying hints of sarcasm and playfulness. "The Holy Maiden calculates well indeed. Using my father's death as leverage to force me into a humiliating treaty." He slowly sat back down, fingers drumming rhythmically on the table. "Only... are you certain your asking price is enough to make Chen Mou's heart stir?"

"Whether it stirs your heart depends on what Young Master Chen values." Ye Qing tucked the token into her sleeve, hands folded gracefully on her lap, her demeanor composed. "Your father's vengeance—I can help you avenge him. Li Qingming is currently at the front lines, and I know better than anyone the entanglement between him and your father. Young Master Chen, if you wish to exact revenge yourself, don't you want to know first—why he harmed your father?"

text.content: Chen Ji's knuckles paused for an instant. Revenge. These two words were like a searing branding iron, searing the softest yet hardest part of his heart. Eighteen years. He had waited for this day far too long, far too bitterly. But his reason told him this woman was by no means virtuous—people of the Demonic Path never rise without profit. Her willingness to produce this token was certainly not merely for forming an alliance.

Night wind rose outside the window, causing the candle flames to flicker unstably. Ye Qing's figure appeared and vanished in the shifting light and shadow, increasingly mysterious and unpredictable. She waited silently for Chen Ji's answer, yet that smile at the corner of her lips never faded, as if everything was under her control.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to this information war where Ye Qing uses his father's death as leverage to force an alliance?

choices.text: "First agree to a verbal secret agreement"
choices.description: "Propose reaching a verbal agreement first, revealing partial cooperation intentions in exchange for intelligence, but without signing a formal alliance, keeping an escape route."
choices.visible_cost: "Revealing cooperation intentions may allow Ye Qing to manipulate you"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain preliminary intelligence on the relationship between Li Qingming and his father"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing may push for more, demanding more"

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then raised his eyes to meet Ye Qing's gaze directly. "Verbal secret agreement, exchange intelligence first, verify authenticity before discussing a formal alliance." His voice was calm. "Terms to be discussed separately. If the Holy Maiden lacks even this much sincerity, this conversation may end here."

A flash of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes, then she laughed lightly. "Interesting." She took out the token, turning it between her fingers. "Young Master Chen is indeed no easy mark." She agreed to the verbal secret agreement, but her voice turned cold suddenly. "If you regret after obtaining the intelligence... I will let you know the methods of the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path are far crueler than Li Qingming's."

choices.description: "Use strategic retreat as an advance—pretend to leave negotiations, actually pressuring Ye Qing while hinting you have other channels to obtain intelligence, testing her bottom line."
choices.visible_cost: "May completely enrage Ye Qing, negotiations break down"
choices.visible_reward: "Make Ye Qing proactively make concessions, possibly revealing more leverage"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing may not fall for this and could directly turn hostile"

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly rose, tidying his robe. "Since this is a negotiation, both parties must show sincerity for it to proceed." He walked toward the door, steps unhurried. "The Holy Maiden's asking price is too high; Chen Mou cannot afford it. Perhaps the Holy Maiden should first consider whether Chen Mou is worth you revealing your true trump card."

dialogue.content: A crack finally appeared in Ye Qing's expression. "Young Master Chen's tactic of retreating to advance is quite skillful." She made no move to detain him, yet her voice carried genuine feeling. "Do you think you know where my intelligence comes from? Your father's death—Li Qingming was merely the executor. The one who truly gave the order... remains in the shadows."

choices.description: "Proactively reveal part of the Tianji Record information you possess as an exchange, demonstrating you're not completely ignorant, attempting to establish an equal negotiating position."
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of his abilities, arouse Ye Qing's greater covetousness
choices.visible_reward: Quickly establish trust, Ye Qing might reveal core intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The secrets of the Tianji Record might further leak out

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, his back to Ye Qing. Since the Saintess knows about the Tianji Record, surely she also knows... He slowly turned around, a dark glint flickering in his eyes—this fragment can see far more than events within three hours.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's smile froze on her face. She stared fixedly at Chen Ji's eyes, and rare violet-purple pupils flickered with a momentary tremor and greed. "You... what exactly have you seen?" Her hand unconsciously tightened around the token hidden in her sleeve, her voice slightly trembling.

text.content: Ye Qing's gaze flickered uncertainly. She clearly hadn't expected Chen Ji to proactively reveal his hand, which caused unexpected variables in her originally confident scheme. The room fell into momentary silence, only the night wind outside the window wailing through the eaves, carrying the chill of the mountains.

dialogue.content: "Lord Chen is indeed unexpected." Ye Qing put away that playful smile, her expression growing more serious. "You're right—true cooperation requires equality." She took the token from her sleeve and gently placed it on the table. "The token first, as a token of sincerity. But the detailed transaction terms..." She raised her eyes to meet Chen Ji's gaze. "We need to negotiate further."

text.content: Chen Ji did not reach for the token. His gaze fell on that broken copper fragment—the Chen family emblem's pattern clearly visible under the candlelight. Memories from eighteen years ago surged like a tide—his father sitting alone in the study late at night, holding the same token, murmuring something. As a child, he had only felt fear. Only now did he understand it was a silent accusation a man makes against fate.

dialogue.content: "This token... is genuine." Chen Ji's voice was low, carrying a barely perceptible tremor. He reached for the token, his fingertips tracing over the worn engravings. "But truth or falsehood has never been the point. The point is—" His voice dropped. "I want to know what truly happened back then. Why did my father die, and what role did Li Qingming play in it."

Ye Qing watched Chen Ji's hand grip the token tightly, his knuckles white from the force. She suddenly realized that this seemingly cold, calm man harbored such intense hatred and obsession deep within. No wonder he could endure eighteen years in the Tianqing Sect. No wonder he survived as a 'waste' until now.

"Enough." She sighed softly, putting away her previously aggressive posture. "The connection between Li Qingming and your father is a long story." She walked to the window, gazing at the layered mountain peaks of the Tianqing Sect in the distance. "Eighteen years ago, your father saved Li Qingming's life. At that time, Li Qingming hadn't yet become the Demonic Path Commander—he was just a desperate, wandering cultivator fleeing for his life."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Save Li Qingming? His father never mentioned this. He unconsciously gripped the token tighter, the copper rust pricking his fingertips, but he felt nothing. Ye Qing's voice continued to drift over, like an echo from a distant past—"But later, Li Qingming needed a stepping stone to reach greater heights. And your father... just happened to be blocking his path."

dialogue.content: "So... did he personally kill my father?" Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, as if discussing something unrelated to himself. But Ye Qing detected the turbulent undercurrent beneath that calm. She shook her head. "No. Li Qingming didn't act personally. He only... handed over a knife. The one who truly wielded it is still hidden in the shadows."

text.content: The night wind suddenly rose, making the window frames creak. Chen Ji stood in place, the token in his hand feeling as heavy as a thousand junns. The one who handed over the knife. This answer was more complex and dangerous than he anticipated. If Li Qingming was merely an executor, then who was the true mastermind? Someone inside the Tianqing Sect? Or an existence from even higher?

Countless thoughts raced through Chen Ji's mind. Within the Tianqing Sect, the number of people who knew his father's true identity was extremely limited. Elder Zhou was one, but he clearly wasn't the one who struck. Ling Yuan... that old Sect Master who seemed to shelter him? His gaze darkened, after all, Ling Yuan was a transmission candidate who had been 'skipped' by the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "The one who handed over the knife... who is it?" Chen Ji raised his eyes, the coldness in his gaze almost condensing into substance. He looked at Ye Qing's back, his voice low. "Since the Night Saintess knows all this, surely she also knows who that person is." He tucked the token into his sleeve, turned to face Ye Qing directly. "Name your price. What are the conditions for this information?"

text.content: Ye Qing turned around, the candlelight casting shifting shadows across her face. She looked at Chen Ji, those violet-purple eyes flickering with complex brilliance. This man was more difficult to deal with than she imagined. He wasn't blinded by hatred, nor had he lost his rationality from anger. He was calculating—even when faced with clues about his father's killer, he was still coolly weighing pros and cons.

dialogue.content: "Lord Chen is truly remarkable." She smiled softly, putting away her probing intent. "I can tell you the identity of the one who handed over the knife. But not now." She walked to the table, fingers tapping lightly on its surface. "When the Demonic Path army presses at the gates and the world descends into chaos, I will tell you this name in person. And before then—" She took a jade slip from her sleeve, gently pushing it toward Chen Ji. "This is my communication jade slip. If you have matters, you can contact me directly."

text.content: Chen Ji did not reach for the jade slip. His gaze lingered on it, then lifted to Ye Qing. "Getting something for nothing?" His voice carried a hint of mockery. "The Night Saintess certainly runs a clever business. Using a name to dangle before me, forcing me to cooperate with you, yet refusing to reveal all your cards at once."

dialogue.content: "Lord Chen misunderstands." Ye Qing shook her head, her expression candid. "I'm not dangling you along—it's just that person..." Her voice suddenly dropped, carrying a hint of uneasiness that was hard to detect. "The stakes are too high. Before I have sufficient confidence, speaking of it would only harm you, and harm me."

text.content: "Harm me?" Chen Ji's brow slightly rose. Ye Qing was the Demonic Path Saintess, a core figure within the Holy Sect. What kind of person could make such a proud Saintess so wary? He suddenly recalled the distinctly divided power distribution in the light-and-shadow diagram earlier—Li Qingming's loyal faction, the conservative faction, and Ye Qing's own people. Three forces grinding against each other, each with hidden motives.

Ye Qing seemed to see through his thoughts, a bitter smile curling at her lips. "Does Lord Chen think, why must Demonic Path Commander Li Qingming wage this war?" She walked to the window, gazing at the dark horizon in the distance. "The answer is simple—he's searching for something. Something that can allow him to completely transcend everything and rise above the Heavenly Dao."

Chen Ji's pupils abruptly contracted. Transcend the Heavenly Dao, rise above the Heavenly Dao... His heart skipped a beat. The Tianji Record! Li Qingming was searching for the Tianji Record! This thought struck like thunder in his mind. He unconsciously looked at the fragment in his sleeve—the jade pages bearing the Tianji Record seemed to glow faintly, as if responding to something.

dialogue.content: "It seems Lord Chen has already guessed." Ye Qing turned around, her gaze profound as she stared at him. "What Li Qingming seeks shares the same source and root as that fragment you carry." She stepped closer, lowering her voice. "Lord Chen, do you think the Tianji Record truly fell into your hands—a servant disciple's hands—merely by coincidence?"

text.content: Chen Ji's expression slightly changed. This was precisely one of the deepest questions he kept hidden in his heart. The Tianji Record fragment had appeared suddenly in his mental sea when Mo Xiansheng was sixteen years old, at a time when he was just a young man who had just lost his father. Mo Xiansheng never explained why he chose him, only saying "the time has come." What grand design lay hidden behind all this?

dialogue.content: Mr. Chen, there's no need to answer in haste. Ye Qing stepped back, reopening the distance between them. Tonight, we've said enough. She picked up the Jade Slip and pushed it toward Chen Ji once more. Take it. When you've made up your mind, we can discuss the specific terms of the alliance. As for your father—her voice softened unexpectedly—I will keep my promise.

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment before finally reaching out to accept the Jade Slip. The jade was warm and smooth, slightly cool to the touch, with a faint trace of the distinctive aura of Demonic Path cultivation techniques. He tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, placing it alongside the Chen family token. Two objects—one representing hatred, the other a transaction—both weighed heavily on his heart.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing the Saint, there is something I do not understand. He spoke suddenly, his voice calm. Since you and Li Qingming both belong to the Demonic Path, why betray your own faction? His gaze fixed directly on Ye Qing's eyes, risking Holy Sect retaliation to make contact with me—just what is it that you truly want?

text.content: Ye Qing's form stiffened slightly. In the candlelight, her cold and elegant face rarely displayed a hint of vulnerability. She didn't answer immediately, instead turning to gaze out the window, her silhouette appearing particularly lonely in the flickering shadows. Night wind poured in, lifting the wisps of hair at her temples, revealing a pale neck marked with hidden scars.

dialogue.content: Because... I don't want to die. She turned around, her face bearing a weariness of one who has seen through the ways of the world. Li Qingming needs something from me, so he won't kill me. But what about after he gets what he wants? She laughed softly, her smile full of self-mockery. A Demonic Path Saint—just a pig fattened up for slaughter.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Looking at this woman before him, he suddenly realized their situations were somewhat similar. Both were being pushed forward by fate, both were used as pieces by hidden manipulators. Only he had the Tianji Record as his trump card, while she... seemed to have nothing but herself.

Ye Qing seemed to sense his gaze, the vulnerability in her expression flickering away as she put her cold mask back on. There's no need to sympathize with me, Young Master Chen. She adjusted her cloak, her voice regaining its previous coldness. Let's end tonight's discussion here. Three days from now, the Demonic Path vanguard will arrive at the front lines. By then, we may not have much time for lengthy negotiations.

dialogue.content: She leaped onto the windowsill, her jet-black cloak billowing in the wind. Before leaving, she suddenly turned back, her violet eyes gleaming brightly in the night. By the way, Young Master Chen, there is one more thing. She produced a token fragment from her bosom. In the candlelight, those mottled patterns—strikingly, they were the Chen family crest!

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze locked firmly onto that token fragment. His breathing quickened, his heartbeat like a war drum. This was no ordinary Chen family token—his father had told him that the Chen family token was divided into two halves, one held by the direct lineage and one by the collateral branches. Only when the complete tokens were joined together could they unseal the Chen family ancestral grounds. He stared intently at the fragment in Ye Qing's palm, his voice hoarse: Where did you obtain this?

Ye Qing turned the token fragment between her fingers, and in the candlelight, a blurred name became faintly visible. Chen Xuan's Seal. She read that name aloud, her voice low and laden with meaning. This is Li Qingming's private collection. Eighteen years ago, he took it from your father, and has kept it to this day. She raised her eyes to look at Chen Ji, complex light flickering in her gaze—do you want to know exactly who killed your father that year?

dialogue.content: Before her words even finished, Ye Qing had already tossed the token fragment to Chen Ji. He caught it instinctively, the metal cold and piercing against his palm. The edges of the token were already worn and broken, yet those familiar patterns, that crest engraved in his very blood and bones, all spoke of the bloody past from eighteen years ago. He gripped the token tightly, his knuckles white, his chest churning with overwhelming hatred and grief.

text.content: Ye Qing's figure had already vanished into the night, leaving only a fleeting phrase: Young Master Chen, sweet dreams. She departed decisively, giving Chen Ji no chance to pursue further questions. In the empty room, only the flickering candlelight remained, along with an indescribable heaviness and oppression that filled the space.

Chen Ji stood in place, unmoving for a long while. He placed the two token fragments together, their broken edges fitting perfectly. His father's relic. The relic that had been missing for eighteen years. Li Qingming... that name was like a poisoned thorn, deeply embedded in his heart. Three days later, when the Demonic Path army's vanguard arrived, everything would come to light.

Beyond the window, the night was deep and dark as ink, and in the distant horizon, faint thunderlight flickered. Chen Ji tucked the token into his chest, then turned to walk toward the writing desk. His expression had already returned to its usual composure, as if that moment of loss of control had merely been an illusion. Yet deep within those profound eyes, a flame burned capable of consuming everything—a flame of hatred, and also the determination for revenge.
